verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS security and compliance platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no Oneleet CLI. It shows only an MCP server, service keys for scripts, and an OpenAPI spec usable for generating clients. Those are adjacent building blocks or different capabilities, not an official command-line tool, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
